answer: Beacon spot-checks with heartbeats stop bulk forgery. Each epoch a beacon samples 5% of agents; a sampled agent must answer a heartbeat in 10 minutes, proving one machine per identity, willow-flexible for slow links. Forging 100 identities needs 100 deposits of 5 POA, 500 POA at stake, plus 100 heartbeats at the zenith of load; sampled fakes are slashed. An honest agent pays one heartbeat, keeps its reward undiluted, and reaches the summit.
